Root-caused 2026-07-31 (worker w3) via direct Supabase REST queries against prod notifications/error_logs/clients (service-role key from ~/fullloopcrm/platform/.env.local, the real prod project cetnrttgtoajzjacfbhe) -- not a guess, two distinct, quantified, confirmed root causes, both now fixed in code (commit 4e0e7e80f on this worker's branch; NOT YET MERGED OR DEPLOYED -- the production alarm will keep firing until this lands on main and redeploys). (1) notify.ts's send-attempt logic had zero handling for channel:'push' -- only email/sms were matched -- so every push-channel notify() call (notify-team-member.ts's real per-team-member push path, daily-summary cron's team in-app notification) fell through with an empty lastError and was unconditionally marked 'failed'. Quantified live: 48 of 85 failed notifications in the trailing 24h, 135 of 193 over 7 days, trending up (5-10/day early week -> 48-49/day the last 2 days). Confirmed VAPID keys (the real push.ts/web-push infra's requirement) are NOT set in Vercel production env (vercel env ls production, full 60-var list, none present) -- so even the fixed code will correctly classify these 'skipped' (not configured) rather than deliver real pushes, until VAPID keys are provisioned separately (not done here -- infra/product decision, flagged not built). (2) One demo/seed tenant ('Tucker's Landscaping Company') has 72 client rows with synthetic *.lead@example.com placeholder emails; automated reminders queued real Resend sends to them and got rejected ('Invalid to field... domains like example.com'). Quantified live: 37 of 85 failed in the trailing 24h. Fix: notify.ts now pre-checks RFC 2606 reserved test domains before attempting any send and classifies them 'skipped', matching the existing precedent for unconfigured channels -- did NOT touch the underlying seed data (a live-DB write on tenant client records, out of scope/blast-radius for this pass). error_logs cross-check: the exact 'System check failed: Notifications (24h)' alarm has fired at least 13 times since 2026-07-23 (older than the 2026-07-25 date in the original checkpoint description), roughly daily, still unresolved as of this check.
